title: Choreomundus – Erasmus Mundus Master in Dance and Movement as Practical Knowledge and Heritage
about: Vytautas Magnus University lists the Choreomundus Erasmus Mundus master's in dance and movement heritage for the 2027-2028 autumn intake. Applications opened 15 October 2026 and close 15 January 2027 for Choreomundus applicants.
card_alt: Card for Choreomundus – Erasmus Mundus Master in Dance and Movement as Practical Knowledge and Heritage at Vytautas Magnus University, Kaunas, Lithuania; deadline 15 Jan 2027. The photo shows Trakai Island Castle in Trakai, Lithuania, not Kaunas.
